name: Paper Crane Storm Shelter
description: A giant origami crane forms a glowing shelter over a tiny village during a luminous rainstorm.
prompt: A single dramatic fantasy image of an enormous origami paper crane with folded wings arching protectively over a miniature village during a luminous rainstorm. The crane is made of translucent white paper with subtle gold creases, glowing softly from within. Raindrops sparkle like beads, villagers hold tiny umbrellas. Moody blue storm clouds, warm lantern light below, high detail, cinematic composition, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: When the storm rolls in, a thousand folds become a roof. Would you take shelter under the paper crane?
